title: paper-v2 daemon emit() does not add payload routing_class - T13 task pending
description: paper-v2 daemon event_log.emit() writes outbox events but does NOT add payload['routing_class']. Per D5 Q2.a + T13 design, paper.daemon.* events should carry routing_class='telemetry' and the canonical capture-trigger events (paper.portfolio_run.completed / paper.daily_snapshot.captured / paper.config.changed) should carry routing_class='archive'. PaperV2ArchiveHandler.can_handle() filters on routing_class to skip telemetry. Currently relies on event_type prefix only. Acceptable while worker disabled (D5 Q2.c default), but blocker for worker enable. paper-v2 INT-5b xfailed pending this fix. Codex REV-1 P1.2 (drawer dae3f130). T13 task #25 pending dispatch (deferred to avoid schema-or-payload churn during T14b/c stabilization).
required_verification: PaperV2ArchiveHandler.can_handle filters daemon events out via routing_class
closure_requirements: T13 dispatch + commit on paper-v2 worktree
Worker enable smoke verifies telemetry events skip handler
